column1: # "You're not alone": battle lines for the "???" fight (battle/party_join.c).
# Battle lines take no {end_wait}, and each is one page: a {page_break} makes
# the battle draw the message in a framed box, so a longer line is two

column3: You stand well alone.\nLet me see what's left\nwhen that breaks.
This is all you are\nwithout them.
I won't watch you\nfall. Not while I can\nstill reach you!
You held our bodies.\nNot our hearts.
He was never alone.\nNot for one moment.
You stubborn idiot!\nDid you think I'd just\nstand there and watch?
We left Vale together.\nWe finish this\ntogether!
I felt you holding on,\nIsaac. It broke\nher hold on me.
We're all here now.\nYou're not alone!
So this is what\nyou are, Isaac.
